coverage: All 18 mainland districts, the Azores and Madeira autonomous regions, all 308 municipalities and all 3,258 civil parishes, with Corvo retained as a terminal municipality in official CAOP2025. Includes all nine Azores islands, Porto Santo, Desertas and the Savage Islands within their official municipalities. Parent geometry dissolves from the same full-resolution parish topology. Population is GISCO 2024 and is not redistributed to 2025 restored parishes. GDP is available for the two autonomous regions; statistical NUTS GDP is not mislabeled as district GDP.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
